# 力扣竞赛

[English Version](/solution/CONTEST_README_EN.md)

## 段位与荣誉勋章

竞赛排名根据竞赛积分（周赛和双周赛）进行计算，注册新用户的基础分值为 1500 分，在竞赛积分 ≥1600 的用户中，根据比例 5%, 20%, 75% 设定三档段位，段位每周比赛结束后计算一次。

如果竞赛积分处于段位的临界值，在每周比赛结束重新计算后会出现段位升级或降级的情况。段位升级或降级后会自动替换对应的荣誉勋章。

| 段位 | 比例 | 段位名   | 国服分数线  | 勋章                                                                                                                    |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| LV3  | 5%   | Guardian | ≥2271.03 | <p><img alt="" src="https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/gh/doocs/leetcode@main/images/Guardian.gif" style="width: 80px;" /></p> |
| LV2  | 20%  | Knight   | ≥1888.95 | <p><img alt="" src="https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/gh/doocs/leetcode@main/images/Knight.gif" style="width: 80px;" /></p>   |
| LV1  | 75%  | -        | -           | -                                                                                                                       |

力扣竞赛 **全国排名前 10** 的用户，全站用户名展示为品牌橙色。

当前分数线对应的守门员，以及最接近但未达到该分数线的用户如下（统计范围为竞赛积分 ≥1600 的 42379 名用户）：

| 段位     | 角色   | 全国排名 | 分数    | 用户                                              |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| Guardian | 守门员 | 2118     | 2271.03 | [rapiz](https://leetcode.cn/u/rapiz/)             |
| Guardian | 差一线 | 2119     | 2270.91 | [harry68](https://leetcode.cn/u/harry68/)         |
| Knight   | 守门员 | 10594    | 1888.95 | [smallwhitez](https://leetcode.cn/u/smallwhitez/) |
| Knight   | 差一线 | 10595    | 1888.93 | [zxbsmk](https://leetcode.cn/u/zxbsmk/)           |

## 赛后估分网站

如果你想在比赛结束后估算自己的积分变化，可以访问网站 [LeetCode Contest Rating Predictor](https://lccn.lbao.site/)。

# LeetCode Contest

[中文文档](/solution/CONTEST_README.md)

## Contest Rating & Badge

The contest badge is calculated based on the contest rating.

For LeetCoders with rating >=1600,
If you are in the top 5% of the contest rating, you’ll get the “Guardian” badge.

If you are in the top 25% of the contest rating, you’ll get the “Knight” badge.

| Level | Proportion | Badge    | Rating      |                                                                                                                         |
| ----- | ---------- | -------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| LV3   | 5\%        | Guardian | ≥2124.20 | <p><img alt="" src="https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/gh/doocs/leetcode@main/images/Guardian.gif" style="width: 80px;" /></p> |
| LV2   | 20\%       | Knight   | ≥1854.34 | <p><img alt="" src="https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/gh/doocs/leetcode@main/images/Knight.gif" style="width: 80px;" /></p>   |
| LV1   | 75\%       | -        | -           | -                                                                                                                       |

For top 10 users (excluding LCCN users), your LeetCode ID will be colored orange on the ranking board. You'll also have the honor with you when you post/comment under discuss.

The global ranking includes LCCN users, so the cutoffs below follow the Guardian / Knight contest badges actually shown on leetcode.com (not a raw 5% / 25% split of the mixed global list).

| Badge    | Role       | Global Rank | Rating   | User                                         |
| -------- | ---------- | ----------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| Guardian | Gatekeeper | 11778       | 2124.198 | [dotuangv](https://leetcode.com/u/dotuangv/) |
| Guardian | Just below | 11779       | 2124.187 | [mad7max](https://leetcode.com/u/mad7max/)   |
| Knight   | Gatekeeper | 53976       | 1854.344 | [sajjad_h](https://leetcode.com/u/sajjad_h/) |
| Knight   | Just below | 53977       | 1854.332 | [amar277](https://leetcode.com/u/amar277/)   |

## Rating Predictor

If you want to estimate your score changes after the contest ends, you can visit the website [LeetCode Contest Rating Predictor](https://lccn.lbao.site/).
